newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - FemRx raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - FemRx raised to buy.

text.p: Robertson, Stephens & Co said analyst Wade King raised his rating on shares of FemRx Inc to buy from long term attractive based on his belief the company will meet his second quarter 1997 revenue forecast of $400,000 and a "very positive" product agreement with Tenet HealthCare.
-- FemRx makes minimally invasive surgical tools for gynecological surgery. Tenet is an operator of medical clinics and hospitals.
-- said expects FemRx to add new agreements with regional hospital and surgical center chains.
-- FemRx shares were up 2/16 at 3-9/16 at midday.
